rationale: The Lean target faithfully retains both parts of Equation (2.5): positivity of lambda makes the original and exponentiated threshold events equal, and the second conjunct is the same exponential Markov bound with probability represented by μ.real and expectation by the real integral. It validly generalizes the finite Bernoulli sum and t ≥ 0 context to arbitrary measurable real S and arbitrary t under explicit exponential integrability. Thus Lean implies the selected source instance, while the selected source statement alone does not imply the full general theorem.
